info.name: Services.AutoTrading Account Values CashManagement - Cash Withdrawal API

items.docs:
Allow client to do cash transfers by giving account key, amount, beneficiary instruction Id, currency and optionally sending “message to beneficiary” with a character limit of 140.
             
Note:

If withdrawal request is created, service will return "201 Created" with cut exchange rate & withdrawal request Id in response.

If withdrawal request is rejected, the service will return bad request with reason for failure of transaction.
